name: runner-service-manager

options.description: Action to perform on the targeted nodes
options.name: mode

options.description: The ecosystem type of Runner to manage
options.name: runner-type

options.description: Deployment Architecture (Standalone creates 1:1 runners. Replica creates a clustered runner pool)
options.name: architecture

options.description:
The logical Parent Runner name this replica belongs to (Only used when Architecture is set to 'replica'). 

Leave blank to automatically group targets into a logical pool (e.g., 'runner-rba-pool-sysd-MyProject'). 

Example: If you type 'frontend-cluster' here, all targeted nodes will group as replicas under a single 'frontend-cluster' runner in the Rundeck UI.
options.name: parent-runner

options.description:
Naming convention for the managed Runner's directory and service structure on the target node. 

Example: 'verbose' creates highly descriptive names like 'runner-rba-rep-sysd-MyProject-node01'. 'standard' uses a simpler legacy format like 'runner-replica-MyProject-node01'.
options.name: runner-naming

options.description: Comma-separated list of additional tags to apply to the runner (e.g., linux,prod,database). Only used when Architecture is set to 'standalone' and Type is 'rba-runner'.
options.name: runner-tags

options.description: Memory allocation for the runner (Applied to -Xms and -Xmx). Only works with install and upgrade modes.
options.name: runner-memory

options.description: Rundeck Project to associate (Leave blank to automatically use the project this job is running in)
options.name: project

options.description: Register and configure the Runner to automatically act as a dispatchable Node within the Rundeck project?
options.name: runner-as-node

options.description: Absolute installation path (Leave blank to use default node working directory)
options.name: work-dir

options.description: Manage the Runner as a Systemd service?
options.name: service-as-systemd

options.description: Manage the Runner with root privileges? (Leave blank for unprivileged User-Space execution)
options.name: service-as-root

options.description: PagerDuty Routing Key for crash alerting (Events V2 API). If provided, configures systemd circuit breaker and ExecStopPost notifications to create a PD incident. Only works when service-as-systemd is true.
options.name: runner-error-routing-key

options.description: Skip errors and resume steps for non-critical exceptions?
options.name: skip-errors

commands.script:
import subprocess
import sys

try:
    java_version = subprocess.check_output(["java", "-version"], stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
    if 'build' not in java_version:
        print("Java not found. Install it before running the job")
        sys.exit(1)
except subprocess.CalledProcessError:
    print("Java not installed. Please install Java before running the job.")
    sys.exit(1)
sys.exit(0)

import os
import json

# Fallback project to the execution context project if left blank
input_project = "@option.project@"
project = input_project if input_project else "@job.project@"

nodeType = "node" if not "@node.runner:runnerId@" else "runner"
runnerType = "@option.runner-type@"
architecture = "@option.architecture@"
parentRunnerInput = "@option.parent-runner@"
svcSystemd = "@option.service-as-systemd@"
namingConvention = "@option.runner-naming@"
nodeName = "@node.name@"
runnerAsNode = "@option.runner-as-node@"
runnerMemory = "@option.runner-memory@"
runnerTags = "@option.runner-tags@"

# Generate Short Codes
type_code = "rba" if runnerType == "rba-runner" else "pd"
arch_code = "rep" if architecture == "replica" else "std"
svc_code = "sysd" if svcSystemd == "true" else "proc"

if nodeType == "runner":
    # If executing on the runner itself, simply adopt the existing local installation name
    workDir = "@option.work-dir@" if "@option.work-dir@" else os.getenv("PWD")
    runner = os.path.basename(workDir)
else:
    # Enforce 'runner-' prefix and apply naming convention intelligently for new installations
    if runnerType == "pd-runner":
        if namingConvention == "verbose":
            runner = f"runner-pd-{svc_code}-{nodeName}"
        else:
            runner = f"runner-pd-{nodeName}"
    else:
        if namingConvention == "verbose":
            runner = f"runner-{type_code}-{arch_code}-{svc_code}-{project}-{nodeName}"
        else:
            prefix = "runner-replica" if architecture == "replica" else "runner"
            runner = f"{prefix}-{project}-{nodeName}"
            
    workDir = f"@option.work-dir@/{runner}" if "@option.work-dir@" else f"{os.getenv('PWD')}/{runner}"

# Smart Parent Runner "Pool" Fallback
parentRunner = parentRunnerInput
if architecture == "replica" and not parentRunnerInput and runnerType == "rba-runner":
    if namingConvention == "verbose":
        parentRunner = f"runner-rba-pool-{svc_code}-{project}"
    else:
        parentRunner = f"runner-pool-{project}"

runnerFlags = f"-Xms{runnerMemory} -Xmx{runnerMemory} -XX:-UsePerfData -Dorg.sqlite.tmpdir={workDir} -Drunner.rundeck.overrideTempDir=true -Drunner.dirs.tmp={workDir}"

configs = {
    "project": project,
    "runner": runner,
    "workDir": workDir,
    "runnerFlags": runnerFlags,
    "architecture": architecture,
    "parentRunner": parentRunner,
    "runnerAsNode": runnerAsNode,
    "runnerType": runnerType,
    "runnerTags": runnerTags
}

print(json.dumps(configs))

import os, signal, sys
runner = "@stub.runner@"
workDir = "@stub.workDir@"
skipErrors = "@stub.skipErrors@"
print(f"Stopping service {runner}")
try:
    os.chdir(workDir)
    with open(f"{runner}.pid", "r") as pid_file:
        pid = int(pid_file.read().strip())
    os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"An error occurred: {e}")
    if skipErrors == "false": sys.exit(1)

import os, json, subprocess, requests
TOKEN = "@stub.rdToken@"
PROJECT = "@stub.project@"
RDURL = "@stub.rdUrl@"
RUNNER = "@stub.runner@"
WORKDIR = "@stub.workDir@"
ARCH = "@stub.architecture@"
PARENT = "@stub.parentRunner@"
RUNNERASNODE = "@stub.runnerAsNode@" == "true"
RUNNERTAGS = "@stub.runnerTags@"

requests.packages.urllib3.disable_warnings()
session = requests.Session()
session.verify = False

try:
    os.makedirs(WORKDIR, exist_ok=True)
    os.chdir(WORKDIR)
    headers = {"X-Rundeck-Auth-Token": TOKEN, "Accept": "application/json", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
    api_base = f"{RDURL}/project/{PROJECT}/runnerManagement"
    
    runner_data = {}

    if ARCH == "replica":
        print(f"Checking Parent Runner {PARENT}")
        res = session.get(f"{api_base}/runners", headers=headers)
        runners = res.json().get('runners', [])
        parent_id = next((r['id'] for r in runners if r['name'] == PARENT), None)
        
        if not parent_id:
            print(f"Creating Parent Runner {PARENT}...")
            payload = {"name": PARENT, "description": "Replica Pool", "assignedProjects": {PROJECT: ".*"}, "installationType": "linux", "replicaType": "manual", "runnerAsNodeEnabled": RUNNERASNODE}
            res = session.post(f"{api_base}/runners", json=payload, headers=headers)
            if res.status_code not in [200, 201]:
                print(f"Failed to create Parent Runner: {res.status_code} - {res.text}"); exit(1)
            
            parent_data = res.json()
            parent_id = parent_data.get('id') or parent_data.get('runnerId')
            if not parent_id:
                check_res = session.get(f"{api_base}/runners", headers=headers)
                parent_id = next((r['id'] for r in check_res.json().get('runners', []) if r['name'] == PARENT), None)
            if not parent_id:
                print("Error: Parent Runner was created but could not retrieve its ID."); exit(1)
            
            rep_res = session.get(f"{api_base}/runner/{parent_id}/replicas", headers=headers)
            existing_replicas = rep_res.json().get('replicas', [])
            dl_token = parent_data.get('downloadTk')
            
            if existing_replicas and dl_token:
                runner_data = {
                    "runnerId": parent_id,
                    "replicaId": existing_replicas[0]['replicaId'],
                    "downloadTk": dl_token
                }
                print(f"Using auto-generated Replica ID: {runner_data['replicaId']}")
            else:
                print(f"Creating Replica for Parent ID: {parent_id}")
                res = session.post(f"{api_base}/runner/{parent_id}/replicas", headers=headers)
                if res.status_code not in [200, 201]:
                    print(f"Failed to create Replica: {res.status_code} - {res.text}"); exit(1)
                runner_data = res.json()
                if existing_replicas:
                    session.delete(f"{api_base}/runner/{parent_id}/replica/{existing_replicas[0]['replicaId']}", headers=headers)
        else:
            print(f"Creating Replica for Parent ID: {parent_id}")
            res = session.post(f"{api_base}/runner/{parent_id}/replicas", headers=headers)
            if res.status_code not in [200, 201]:
                print(f"Failed to create Replica: {res.status_code} - {res.text}"); exit(1)
            runner_data = res.json()
            
        with open(f"{WORKDIR}/.replica-meta", "w") as f:
            json.dump(runner_data, f)
        registered_runner_id = runner_data.get('runnerId')
        registered_replica_id = runner_data.get('replicaId')
        dl_token = runner_data.get('downloadTk')
        if not dl_token:
             print("Error: No download token received for replica."); exit(1)
    else:
        print(f"Creating Standalone Runner {RUNNER} on {WORKDIR}")
        tags_list = [RUNNER]
        if RUNNERTAGS:
            tags_list.extend([t.strip() for t in RUNNERTAGS.split(',') if t.strip()])
        tags_list = list(set(tags_list))
        payload = {"name": RUNNER, "description": RUNNER, "tagNames": tags_list, "assignedProjects": {PROJECT: ".*"}, "installationType": "linux", "replicaType": "manual", "runnerAsNodeEnabled": RUNNERASNODE}
        res = session.post(f"{api_base}/runners", json=payload, headers=headers)
        if res.status_code not in [200, 201]:
             print(f"Failed to create Standalone Runner: {res.status_code} - {res.text}"); exit(1)
        
        runner_data = res.json()
        registered_runner_id = runner_data.get('id') or runner_data.get('runnerId')
        if not registered_runner_id:
             check_res = session.get(f"{api_base}/runners", headers=headers)
             registered_runner_id = next((r['id'] for r in check_res.json().get('runners', []) if r['name'] == RUNNER), None)

        dl_token = runner_data.get('downloadTk')
        if not dl_token and registered_runner_id:
             regen_res = session.post(f"{api_base}/runner/{registered_runner_id}/regenerateCreds", headers=headers)
             dl_token = regen_res.json().get('downloadTk')
             
        if not dl_token:
             print("Error: No download token received for standalone runner."); exit(1)

    # Risky operations block (Download & SSL)
    try:
        print(f"Downloading JAR...")
        response = session.get(f"{RDURL}/runnerManagement/download/{dl_token}", headers=headers, stream=True)
        if response.status_code == 200:
            with open(f"{RUNNER}.jar", "wb") as f:
                f.write(response.content)
        else:
            raise Exception(f"Error downloading the runner: {response.status_code} - {response.text}")

        if RDURL.startswith("https://"):
            CERT = f"{RUNNER}.crt"
            STOREPASS = "changeit"
            STOREPATH = f"{WORKDIR}/truststore"
            HOST = RDURL.replace("https://", "").split('/')[0]
            subprocess.run(f"keytool -printcert -rfc -sslserver {HOST} > {CERT}", shell=True, check=True)
            subprocess.run(f"rm -f {STOREPATH} && keytool -v -noprompt -importcert -alias {RUNNER} -file {CERT} -storepass {STOREPASS} -keystore {STOREPATH}", shell=True, check=True)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Installation failed during setup: {e}")
        print("Rolling back API registration (Orphan Prevention)...")
        if ARCH == "replica":
            if registered_runner_id and registered_replica_id:
                session.delete(f"{api_base}/runner/{registered_runner_id}/replica/{registered_replica_id}", headers=headers)
            if os.path.exists(f"{WORKDIR}/.replica-meta"): os.remove(f"{WORKDIR}/.replica-meta")
        else:
            if registered_runner_id:
                session.delete(f"{api_base}/runner/{registered_runner_id}", headers=headers)
        exit(1)

finally:
    session.close()

import os, subprocess, json, requests
TOKEN = "@stub.rdToken@"
SVCROOT = "@stub.serviceAsRoot@"
PROJECT = "@stub.project@"
RDURL = "@stub.rdUrl@"
RUNNER = "@stub.runner@"
WORKDIR = "@stub.workDir@"
RUNNERFLAGS = "@stub.runnerFlags@"
ARCH = "@stub.architecture@"
PARENT = "@stub.parentRunner@"
RUNNERASNODE = "@stub.runnerAsNode@" == "true"
RUNNERTAGS = "@stub.runnerTags@"

requests.packages.urllib3.disable_warnings()
session = requests.Session()
session.verify = False
headers = {"X-Rundeck-Auth-Token": TOKEN, "Accept": "application/json", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
api_base = f"{RDURL}/project/{PROJECT}/runnerManagement"

def create_runner():
    if ARCH == "replica":
        print(f"Checking Parent Runner {PARENT}")
        res = session.get(f"{api_base}/runners", headers=headers)
        runners = res.json().get('runners', [])
        parent_id = next((r['id'] for r in runners if r['name'] == PARENT), None)
        
        if not parent_id:
            print(f"Creating Parent Runner {PARENT}...")
            payload = {"name": PARENT, "description": "Replica Pool", "assignedProjects": {PROJECT: ".*"}, "installationType": "linux", "replicaType": "manual", "runnerAsNodeEnabled": RUNNERASNODE}
            res = session.post(f"{api_base}/runners", json=payload, headers=headers)
            if res.status_code not in [200, 201]:
                print(f"Failed to create Parent Runner: {res.status_code} - {res.text}"); exit(1)
                
            parent_data = res.json()
            parent_id = parent_data.get('id') or parent_data.get('runnerId')
            if not parent_id:
                check_res = session.get(f"{api_base}/runners", headers=headers)
                parent_id = next((r['id'] for r in check_res.json().get('runners', []) if r['name'] == PARENT), None)
            if not parent_id:
                print("Error: Parent Runner was created but could not retrieve its ID."); exit(1)
            
            rep_res = session.get(f"{api_base}/runner/{parent_id}/replicas", headers=headers)
            existing_replicas = rep_res.json().get('replicas', [])
            dl_token = parent_data.get('downloadTk')
            
            if existing_replicas and dl_token:
                runner_data = {
                    "runnerId": parent_id,
                    "replicaId": existing_replicas[0]['replicaId'],
                    "downloadTk": dl_token
                }
                print(f"Using auto-generated Replica ID: {runner_data['replicaId']}")
            else:
                print(f"Creating Replica for Parent ID: {parent_id}")
                res = session.post(f"{api_base}/runner/{parent_id}/replicas", headers=headers)
                if res.status_code not in [200, 201]:
                    print(f"Failed to create Replica: {res.status_code} - {res.text}"); exit(1)
                runner_data = res.json()
                if existing_replicas:
                    session.delete(f"{api_base}/runner/{parent_id}/replica/{existing_replicas[0]['replicaId']}", headers=headers)
        else:
            print(f"Creating Replica for Parent ID: {parent_id}")
            res = session.post(f"{api_base}/runner/{parent_id}/replicas", headers=headers)
            if res.status_code not in [200, 201]:
                print(f"Failed to create Replica: {res.status_code} - {res.text}"); exit(1)
            runner_data = res.json()
            
        with open(f"{WORKDIR}/.replica-meta", "w") as f:
            json.dump(runner_data, f)
        return runner_data
    else:
        print(f"Installing Standalone Runner {RUNNER} on {WORKDIR}")
        tags_list = [RUNNER]
        if RUNNERTAGS:
            tags_list.extend([t.strip() for t in RUNNERTAGS.split(',') if t.strip()])
        tags_list = list(set(tags_list))
        payload = {"name": RUNNER, "description": RUNNER, "tagNames": tags_list, "assignedProjects": {PROJECT: ".*"}, "installationType": "linux", "replicaType": "manual", "runnerAsNodeEnabled": RUNNERASNODE}
        response = session.post(f"{api_base}/runners", json=payload, headers=headers)
        if response.status_code in [200, 201]:
            runner_data = response.json()
            registered_id = runner_data.get('id') or runner_data.get('runnerId')
            if not registered_id:
                 check_res = session.get(f"{api_base}/runners", headers=headers)
                 registered_id = next((r['id'] for r in check_res.json().get('runners', []) if r['name'] == RUNNER), None)
                 runner_data['id'] = registered_id
            if not runner_data.get('downloadTk') and registered_id:
                 regen_res = session.post(f"{api_base}/runner/{registered_id}/regenerateCreds", headers=headers)
                 runner_data['downloadTk'] = regen_res.json().get('downloadTk')
            return runner_data
        else:
            print(f"Failed to create Standalone Runner: {response.status_code} - {response.text}"); exit(1)

def download_runner(runnerResponse):
    dl_token = runnerResponse.get("downloadTk")
    if not dl_token:
        raise Exception("No download token found in the API response.")
        
    response = session.get(f"{RDURL}/runnerManagement/download/{dl_token}", headers={"X-Rundeck-Auth-Token": TOKEN, "Accept": "application/json"}, stream=True)
    if response.status_code == 200:
        with open(f"{RUNNER}.jar", "wb") as jar_file:
            jar_file.write(response.content)
    else:
        raise Exception(f"Failed to download runner JAR: {response.status_code} - {response.text}")

def check_ssl():
    if "https://" in RDURL:
        cert = f"{RUNNER}.crt"; storepass = "changeit"; storepath = f"{WORKDIR}/truststore"
        host = RDURL.replace("https://", "").split("/")[0]
        subprocess.run(["keytool", "-printcert", "-rfc", "-sslserver", host], stdout=open(cert, "w"), check=True)
        subprocess.run(["rm", "-f", storepath], check=False)
        subprocess.run(["keytool", "-v", "-noprompt", "-importcert", "-alias", RUNNER, "-file", cert, "-storepass", storepass, "-keystore", storepath], check=True)
        return f"-Dmicronaut.ssl.trust-store.password={storepass} -Dmicronaut.ssl.trust-store.path=file:{storepath}"
    return ""

def create_service(ssl_options):
    print(f"Creating service {RUNNER}")
    
    if not SVCROOT:
        try:
            user = os.getenv("USER") or subprocess.check_output(["id", "-un"]).strip().decode('utf-8')
            linger_status = subprocess.check_output(f"loginctl show-user {user}", shell=True, text=True)
            if "Linger=no" in linger_status:
                print(f"Enabling linger for user {user}...")
                subprocess.run(["loginctl", "enable-linger", user], check=True)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"Warning: Could not check/set linger status automatically: {e}")

    ROUTING_KEY = "@option.runner-error-routing-key@"
    webhook_str = ""
    if ROUTING_KEY:
        import json as j
        payload = {
            "routing_key": ROUTING_KEY,
            "event_action": "trigger",
            "dedup_key": RUNNER,
            "payload": {
                "summary": f"{RUNNER} crashed on $(hostname)",
                "source": "$(hostname)",
                "severity": "critical",
                "component": "runner"
            }
        }
        payload_str = j.dumps(payload).replace('"', '\\"')
        webhook_str = f"ExecStopPost=/bin/sh -c 'if [ \"$$SERVICE_RESULT\" != \"success\" ]; then curl -s -k -X POST -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -H \"Accept: application/json\" --data \"{payload_str}\" https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue; fi'\n"

    service_content = f"""[Unit]\nDescription=RBA Runner [{RUNNER}]\nStartLimitIntervalSec=60\nStartLimitBurst=3\n[Service]\nRestart=on-failure\nRestartSec=5\nSuccessExitStatus=3 4 143\nRestartForceExitStatus=3 4\nNoNewPrivileges=true\nWorkingDirectory={WORKDIR}\nExecStart=java {RUNNERFLAGS} {ssl_options} -jar {WORKDIR}/{RUNNER}.jar\n{webhook_str}[Install]\nWantedBy=default.target\n"""
    with open(f"{WORKDIR}/{RUNNER}.service", "w") as service_file:
        service_file.write(service_content)
    if not SVCROOT:
        user_systemd_dir = os.path.join(os.getenv("HOME"), ".config", "systemd", "user")
        os.makedirs(user_systemd_dir, exist_ok=True)

import os, json, requests, subprocess
TOKEN = "@stub.rdToken@"
PROJECT = "@stub.project@"
RDURL = "@stub.rdUrl@"
RUNNER = "@stub.runner@"
WORKDIR = "@stub.workDir@"
ARCH = "@stub.architecture@"

requests.packages.urllib3.disable_warnings()
session = requests.Session(); session.verify = False
headers = {"X-Rundeck-Auth-Token": TOKEN, "Accept": "application/json", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
api_base = f"{RDURL}/project/{PROJECT}/runnerManagement"

os.chdir(WORKDIR)
print(f"Upgrading {RUNNER} on {WORKDIR}")

if ARCH == "replica":
    try:
        with open(f"{WORKDIR}/.replica-meta", "r") as f:
            meta = json.load(f)
    except:
        print("No .replica-meta found. Cannot safely upgrade."); exit(1)
    
    print("Deleting old Replica API token...")
    session.delete(f"{api_base}/runner/{meta['runnerId']}/replica/{meta['replicaId']}", headers=headers)
    
    print("Generating new Replica token...")
    res = session.post(f"{api_base}/runner/{meta['runnerId']}/replicas", headers=headers)
    new_meta = res.json()
    with open(f"{WORKDIR}/.replica-meta", "w") as f:
        json.dump(new_meta, f)
    dl_token = new_meta['downloadTk']
else:
    response = session.get(f"{api_base}/runners", headers=headers)
    if response.status_code == 200:
        runners = response.json().get("runners", [])
        runner_info = next((r for r in runners if r["name"] == RUNNER), None)
        if runner_info:
            runner_id = runner_info.get("id")
            res = session.post(f"{RDURL}/runnerManagement/runner/{runner_id}/regenerateCreds", headers=headers)
            dl_token = res.json().get("downloadTk")
        else:
            print(f"Runner {RUNNER} not found on server."); exit(1)

print("Downloading updated JAR...")
dl_res = session.get(f"{RDURL}/runnerManagement/download/{dl_token}", headers=headers)
with open(f"{RUNNER}.jar", "wb") as f:
    f.write(dl_res.content)
print("Upgrade complete. Restarting service will apply the new JAR.")

ruleset.rules:
# status
[status-post] if:option.service-as-systemd==false if:option.mode==status
[status-systemd-post] if:option.service-as-systemd==true if:option.mode==status
# start
[start-post,status-post] if:option.service-as-systemd==false if:option.mode==start
[start-systemd-post,status-systemd-post] if:option.service-as-systemd==true if:option.mode==start
# stop
[stop,status-post] if:option.service-as-systemd==false if:option.mode==stop
[stop-systemd,status-systemd-post] if:option.service-as-systemd==true if:option.mode==stop
# restart
[stop,start-post,status-post] if:option.service-as-systemd==false if:option.mode==restart
[stop-systemd,start-systemd-post,status-systemd-post] if:option.service-as-systemd==true if:option.mode==restart
# install-only (RBA-RUNNER)
[install,status-post] if:option.service-as-systemd==false if:option.mode==install-only if:option.runner-type==rba-runner
[install-systemd,status-systemd-post] if:option.service-as-systemd==true if:option.mode==install-only if:option.runner-type==rba-runner
# install-start (RBA-RUNNER)
[install,start-post,status-post] if:option.service-as-systemd==false if:option.mode==install-start if:option.runner-type==rba-runner
[install-systemd,start-systemd-post,status-systemd-post] if:option.service-as-systemd==true if:option.mode==install-start if:option.runner-type==rba-runner
# install-only (PD-RUNNER)
[install-pd,status-post] if:option.service-as-systemd==false if:option.mode==install-only if:option.runner-type==pd-runner if:option.pd-token=~.* if:option.pd-runner-id=~.* if:option.pd-runner-secret=~.*
[install-pd-systemd,status-systemd-post] if:option.service-as-systemd==true if:option.mode==install-only if:option.runner-type==pd-runner if:option.pd-token=~.* if:option.pd-runner-id=~.* if:option.pd-runner-secret=~.*
# install-start (PD-RUNNER)
[install-pd,start-post,status-post] if:option.service-as-systemd==false if:option.mode==install-start if:option.runner-type==pd-runner if:option.pd-token=~.* if:option.pd-runner-id=~.* if:option.pd-runner-secret=~.*
[install-pd-systemd,start-systemd-post,status-systemd-post] if:option.service-as-systemd==true if:option.mode==install-start if:option.runner-type==pd-runner if:option.pd-token=~.* if:option.pd-runner-id=~.* if:option.pd-runner-secret=~.*
# uninstall
[stop,uninstall,status-post] if:option.service-as-systemd==false if:option.mode==uninstall
[stop-systemd,uninstall-systemd,status-systemd-post] if:option.service-as-systemd==true if:option.mode==uninstall
# upgrade
[stop,upgrade,start-post,status-post] if:option.service-as-systemd==false if:option.mode==upgrade if:option.runner-type==rba-runner
[stop-systemd,upgrade,start-systemd-post,status-systemd-post] if:option.service-as-systemd==true if:option.mode==upgrade if:option.runner-type==rba-runner
